text: Kieran - 2nd interview @ Deloitte 14 Nov. v nervous, hasn't slept properly. text him good luck the night before
Adaeze knee op went fine, home Thurs. crutches for 6 wks. her mum staying w/ her till Christmas
Thabo applied for the head chef job at the Ivy, hears back sometime next month
Akira - hip replacement booked 3rd of December. wife Sinead driving him in. ask how recovery going after New Year
dentist 09/11 @ 8.40, then car MOT same wk
Esther Moreau (Essie) - retiring end of March 2027 after 31 yrs @ the council. leaving do TBC. chip in for gift?
Rahul: interview at Monzo cancelled, they froze hiring. gutted. now looking at contracting instead
Ming + Zhang - wedding 2 May 2027, Lake District. save the date coming. Zhang veggie, Ming coeliac
Lucy's dad had a fall, in St James's since Sat. she's v stressed, back and forth every evening. check in w/ her Fri
Owen got the job!! starts @ Sky 12 Jan. buy him a pint
Oliver - colonoscopy 21/11, nervous abt the prep more than anything. offered to drive him, I'm picking him up at 2
Tariq's sister Yara graduating in the summer - law, Durham. he's flying back from Dubai for it
Shreya - cat Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday, stitches out 10 days. she's working from home to keep an eye
must ring Mohammed re: his scan results - he was waiting on them last wk, think they were due Tue
Adriana - moving to Lisbon in the spring, new role w/ same firm. learning Portuguese, v keen on surfing
Santiago into Arsenal, season ticket holder. hates Spurs (obv). bday 19th of Feb - shirt?
Kiara phone interview went well, final round sometime after half term. she wants the job badly, kind of anxious
Alice + Ryan expecting! due early June. she's had awful morning sickness. Ryan already painting the nursery
Emre - Uncle Kemal's bypass postponed again, now 'early in the new year'. Emre fed up, family all on edge. text Emre this wknd
Ana cataract op 7 Nov. can't drive for a fortnight after. I'm doing her shopping that wk
pick up prescription, book GP for flu jab before end of Oct
Rebecca Usman - new practice manager @ the surgery. used to be at Guy's. knows Dr Lee
Oisín's rugby trial for the county squad Sat 15/11. he's 14, mad keen, bit nervous. ask his dad Tomás how it went
Blessing finally heard back - didn't get the NHS band 6 post. said she's fine but sounded flat. maybe take her for coffee sometime next wk
Aurelio - knee still bad since the 10k in Sept, physio twice a week. no running till spring at least
Anya & her partner Owen doing a big housewarming 29 Nov. new place in Walthamstow. bring wine, she likes red
Akira home from hospital!! op went well, walking w/ frame already. Sinead says he's grumpy and bored. send him a book? he reads crime

Kieran heard nothing from Deloitte yet, it's been nearly 2 wks since the 14th. chasing them Mon. told him no news is good news but he's convinced he messed up the case study. his partner Rebecca says he's been checking emails at 3am. also has a backup interview w/ PwC sometime early Dec. remind me to text him Tues
follow up w/ Thabo re the Ivy job - he should've heard by now
Yara - started PhD @ Edinburgh this autumn, marine biology. lives with 2 flatmates + dog Pip
Rahul's wife Esther's grandmother passed away Sunday. funeral Thurs 6th in Leicester. send card
Mohammed results clear. huge relief. he & his wife off to Morocco in Jan to celebrate

Lucy - dad discharged 1 Nov, going into respite care for a bit, then home w/ carers hopefully before Christmas. Lucy exhausted, back at work part time, her brother finally helping out a bit. she mentioned wanting a weekend away 'sometime soon', spa or somewhere quiet. could be a nice bday thing, hers is 2nd of Feb. should check in w/ her next wk
Tomás starting a new job w/ Network Rail sometime in Dec, notice period still being sorted. he's pleased, less commuting

Called Adriana. Lisbon move pushed to summer now, visa stuff. Her brother Santiago helping her pack up the flat. Need to get her a leaving present before she goes, she mentioned wanting a decent Portuguese cookbook. Also she's having leaving drinks at the Crown some Fri in June, date tbc. Don't forget to put it in the calendar once she sends it.

Shreya's interview for the senior designer job at the BBC is on 4 November at 10. Prepping all wknd, says she's terrified of the portfolio bit. Her mum keeps calling to calm her down lol. text her the morning of, and ask her on the Wed how it went

Long chat w/ Emre. Kemal's op is finally on - 12th of January 2027 @ Harefield. Emre's taking 2 wks off to look after his aunt + cousins. He's been really low, not sleeping, says work's been understanding though. His boss Mr Jensen has been decent. I said I'd go up and visit while Kemal's in. Ring Emre the day after the op
Blessing - applying for the Imperial research post now, deadline 30/11. asked me to look over her personal statement. do that this wk
weekend: ironing, gym Sat am, mum's for Sunday roast

Zhang - promoted to team lead @ Arup last month, 8 people under him now. working mad hours, Ming says he's barely home before 9. still climbing every Weds though, says it's the only thing keeping him sane. wants to do a climbing trip to Kalymnos in May 2027, after the wedding. birthday 30 Nov, chalk bag or a guidebook?
Ming's hen do sometime March 2027 - Edinburgh probably. Alice organising. I'm in charge of the quiz
Owen - leaving drinks from BT on Fri 12 Dec, then straight over to Sky in Jan
Oliver colonoscopy all fine, just a polyp removed. results back in 2-3 wks. he's v relieved
Kiara - gift idea: she's into pottery, keeps talking about a wheel class. bday 8 Jan
Sinead - her own op (gallbladder) sometime in the new year, waiting list. not telling Akira till he's better. she's coping but tired
Rebecca - son Ryan has his driving test 26/11, 3rd attempt. she's more nervous than him
Tariq - interview for Emirates cabin crew 18 Nov, flying to Dubai the wk before to see family. text him luck
Called the hospital re Adaeze's follow-up appt - moved to 17th of Dec. let her know

Thabo didn't get the Ivy job. Thinks they went internal. Shrugged it off, already has 2 more applications in - one at the Savoy, deadline mid Nov, other at a place in Bristol which would mean moving w/ his girlfriend Lucy. He's v into Japanese cooking lately, doing a course Tues evenings. ask him abt the Savoy sometime after the 20th
Alice - 20wk scan 3 Jan. Ryan can't make it, working away in Aberdeen. her sister Anya going instead
must sort Owen's card + bottle for leaving do on the 12th
Aurelio's dog Rocco - poorly, at the vet overnight. Aurelio worried sick. check in tomorrow
Santiago Williams - our new neighbour at no. 14. nurse at the Royal Free, nights mostly. 2 kids, wife Ana
Esther - had her retirement date confirmed: 31 March 2027. wants to travel, says Japan first. hates fuss so no big party
Kemal - Emre's uncle. diabetic, ex-smoker. lives in Harrow w/ his wife

Akira - physio appts Mondays from 10/11 for 6 wks @ the Whittington. Sinead can't always drive since her own back's playing up, I'll do the 17th and 24th. their son Oliver covering the rest when he's not on shift. Akira wants to be walking the dog Miso by Christmas, ambitious but fair enough. text Sinead to confirm times
renew passport!! expires 02/2027. before booking anything for spring

Rahul's contracting gig starts 1st Dec, 6-month contract w/ Barclays, mostly remote, in Canary Wharf 2 days. relieved after the Monzo thing, though still a bit wobbly abt money - mortgage renewal due March 2027. his dad keeps asking when he'll get a 'proper job' haha. Esther doing better since the funeral
Ana's eye op - all good, can see properly again, says colours are brighter. Santiago back on nights from Mon

Kiara - final round on 25 November, presentation to the board. pretty scared, practising on her housemate Oisín. remind me to message her that morning, maybe flowers if she gets it. her mum Rebecca coming down to stay that wknd for moral support
